'''Safari One''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of ten [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]] that were [[Mission to Goratak III|dispatched]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goratak III]] to recover an [[I2-CG droid/Legends|I2-CG]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] ejected from a [[Tech 4 PDV]]. They were armed with [[Hunting blaster/Legends|hunting blasters]] and a tripod-mounted [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]].
